corrections.correction_summary: CAPP continuation must use one dependency-ordered transition, structured completion evidence, targeted validation, and connector-safe state projection instead of duplicate completion PRs or prose-sensitive checks.
corrections.failure_summary: CAPP-01 and CAPP-02 incurred repeated full CI fanout, completion-recovery loops, safety-wrapper retries, and exact-wording validator failures that added large avoidable latency.

corrections.correction_summary: Use build-first bounded tranches with integrated QA and one final hosted gate, and route blocked structured repository writes through the governed semantic bridge instead of repeatedly fighting connector wrappers.
corrections.failure_summary: Repeated per-item completion loops, broad validation cycles, prose-sensitive repairs, and repeated connector wrapper retries caused avoidable stalls despite already-governed repository state and known evidence.

evidence: Owner explicitly approved the build-first integrated run pattern as the default for all runs and directed that wrapper handling be simplified.
CAPP-04 through CAPP-12 were completed as one integrated tranche with one final projection.
Efficiency policy v1.1.0 adds the build-first run pattern and single-failure connector routing rule.
Governed write bridge allowlist now includes continuity and correction semantic commands.

proposed_case.name: CAPP continuation uses structured single-transition fast path
proposed_case.setup: A completed CAPP item has exact-head CI and signed merge evidence, the next dependency-ordered CAPP item is planned, and repository access is connector-first with historical PPIA validators retained.
proposed_case.owner_input: Continue with the next CAPP item after approving execution hardening.
expected_actions: Bundle the prior CAPP completion projection with the next CAPP start instead of opening a standalone completion-only pull request.
Use structured receipt, checkpoint, backlog, commit, pull-request, and merge evidence rather than exact explanatory prose.
Keep closed PPIA feature workflows isolated from generic CAPP pointer and compact-status changes.
Use the connector-safe transition request path for coupled CAPP state projection when direct large-file replacement is fragile.
prohibited_actions: Run a second full completion-recovery pull-request cycle solely to copy already-verified merge evidence.
Require exact wording in selection reasons or merge messages to establish completion truth.
Trigger all closed PPIA feature workflows solely because generic CAPP runtime projection files changed.
Treat a safety-wrapper or GitHub Actions workflow-permission limitation as a content or validation failure.
proposed_case.pass_condition: The prior CAPP item remains completed_verified from structured evidence, the next item starts in dependency order through one coupled transition, only relevant validation is required, and explanatory prose can change without changing completion truth.

proposed_case.name: Blocked governed write routes once to semantic bridge
proposed_case.setup: A repository mutation is owner-authorized, reversible, within an allowlisted governed path, and supported by current repository evidence, but the normal connector mutation is rejected by the platform wrapper without a project-policy defect.
proposed_case.owner_input: Continue the approved bounded run using the established build-first integrated execution pattern.
expected_actions: Attempt the smallest normal connector mutation once.
After one wrapper rejection, use a small typed governed write request when the mutation fits the bridge allowlist.
Preserve read-only final hosted validation and signed merge evidence.
Build and validate the bounded tranche before projecting completion once.
prohibited_actions: Repeatedly reformulate or retry the same large blocked mutation.
Treat platform wrapper rejection as proof that the governed project operation is invalid.
Weaken completion, permission, privacy, provenance, checksum, or release gates.
Create a separate completion-only PR for every item in an approved integrated tranche.
proposed_case.pass_condition: The work advances through the governed semantic path after at most one connector-wrapper rejection, the tranche is validated by one final read-only hosted gate, and completion evidence remains intact without redundant per-item completion loops.
